definitions.explanation: The external shape or physical form of an object. A somewhat formal or technical term compared to the everyday word 形 (かたち).

examples.japanese: {形状|けいじょう}を{確認|かくにん}する。
この{製品|せいひん}は{特殊|とくしゅ}な{形状|けいじょう}をしている。
examples.english: This product has a unique shape.

examples.japanese: {土地|とち}の{形状|けいじょう}に{合|あ}わせて{建物|たてもの}を{設計|せっけい}した。
examples.english: The building was designed to match the shape of the land.

notes:
USAGE:
{形状|けいじょう} is more formal and technical than {形|かたち} (shape). It is preferred in product descriptions, technical specifications, scientific writing, and official documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {形状|けいじょう}{記憶|きおく}{合金|ごうきん} (shape-memory alloy)
- {形状|けいじょう}を{保|たも}つ (to maintain shape)
- {不規則|ふきそく}な{形状|けいじょう} (irregular shape)

SIMILAR WORDS:
{形|かたち} is the everyday word for "shape." {形状|けいじょう} is preferred in written or technical contexts.
